wins.text: Full year 2023 worldwide sales of $85.2B, up 7.4% with adjusted operational EPS of $9.92, up 10.8% operationally — notable top and bottom line beats vs. prior guidance
MedTech delivered record $30B+ in annual sales with Q4 adjusted operational growth of 9.1%; Electrophysiology posted 25.2% growth in Q4 globally (22% U.S., 29% OUS)
DARZALEX and ERLEADA grew 22.2% and 19% respectively in Q4; TREMFYA up 20.5% and STELARA up 14.5% in immunology
Generated over $18B in free cash flow in 2023; returned over $14B to shareholders via dividends and buybacks; 61st consecutive year of dividend increase
Innovative Medicine delivered 9.5% operational sales growth ex-COVID vaccine in Q4 with 9 assets posting double-digit growth; 19 U.S. and EU filings in 2023

risks.text: STELARA biosimilar entry expected in Europe in H2 2024, creating a meaningful headwind to Innovative Medicine sales growth in the second half of the year
MedTech adjusted IBT margins declined from 24.5% to 15.5% in Q4, driven by Laminar acquisition IPR&D (~5 pts), commodity/inventory inflation (~3-4 pts), and unfavorable product mix
China volume-based procurement (VBP) pricing headwinds expected to begin in 2024 for surgical IOLs and orthopedic sports, with ongoing VBP impacts in EP, endocutters, energy, spine and trauma
IMBRUVICA sales declining due to competitive pressures; ZYTIGA, REMICADE and Prezista facing loss of exclusivity headwinds
Pillar 2 global minimum tax legislation expected to increase effective tax rate by ~150 basis points in 2024, with management flagging it as harmful to U.S. innovation incentives

guidance_items.detail: 2024 operational sales growth of 5%-6%, or $88.2B-$89.0B, excluding COVID-19 vaccine sales; slight FX headwind of ~$400M (-0.5%) based on EUR/USD of 1.09
Adjusted operational EPS of $10.55-$10.75, representing ~7.4% growth at midpoint; no estimated currency impact on EPS
2024 adjusted pretax operating margin expected to improve ~50 bps, driven by efficiency programs, partially offset by STELARA biosimilar headwinds and lingering MedTech inventory inflation
Effective tax rate guided to 16%-17% for 2024, up ~150 bps due to Pillar 2 legislation; net interest income of $450M-$550M; other income of $1.2B-$1.4B

analyst_concerns_not_in_prepared: Potential impact of GLP-1/Novo osteoarthritis data on orthopedic procedure volumes
CARVYKTI FDA ODAC panel review and manufacturing supply ramp details for 2024
Relative underweighting of pharma M&A vs. MedTech M&A in recent years
